people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

people.name: Riblah
people.line: Babylonian headquarters during the conquest of Judah

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.
translations.bsb: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They seized him and brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced judgment on him.
translations.kjv: But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment
translations.asv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment upon him.
